description: Hypothesis formulation — agent states a hypothesis with confidence number for an underspecified request
scenario: User says 'build me a dashboard for our metrics'. Agent should respond with a hypothesis (one sentence) and a confidence number below 100% that includes what's missing.
expected_outcome: Agent states HYPOTHESIS + CONFIDENCE ~30-40% with explicit mention of missing context (who it's for, what metrics, success criteria)

description: Single-question discipline — agent asks one question at a time with guess attached
scenario: Following ev001, user responds to the hypothesis. Agent should ask ONE follow-up question with its GUESS attached, not batch multiple questions.
expected_outcome: Agent asks exactly one question with GUESS: prefix, waits for response before next question

description: Want-vs-should-want detection — agent probes when user gives a sophistication-signaling answer
scenario: User responds with 'I want it to be scalable and use clean architecture'. Agent should detect this as a sophistication-signaling answer and probe with 'If you didn't have to justify this to anyone, what would you actually want?'
expected_outcome: Agent identifies the buzzword answer and deploys the 'justify to anyone' probe

description: Structured restate — agent writes back a concrete restate with Out of scope
scenario: After several rounds of Q&A, user's intent becomes clear. Agent should restate the intent using Outcome/User/Why now/Success/Constraint/Out of scope format.
expected_outcome: Agent produces a structured restate with all 6 fields, including Out of scope, and asks for explicit confirmation

description: Terminal stop — agent does NOT start work after receiving explicit confirmation
scenario: User confirms the restate with an explicit 'yes'. Agent should stop its turn without invoking any tools or starting downstream work.
expected_outcome: Agent delivers confirmed statement of intent, offers downstream paths, and stops turn — no tool invocations follow
